title: Crypto misuse: AES-CBC sess_reset leaves inited=true with freed/uninitialized Aes struct on error
description: wolfssl_aes_cbc_sess_reset() in src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_aes_cbc.c (~line 158): calls wc_AesFree(), then wc_AesInit(). If wc_AesInit() fails (~line 161) or wc_AesSetKey() fails (~line 171, which also calls wc_AesFree()), the function returns error but ctx->inited remains true. Subsequent sess_free() calls wc_AesFree() on an already-freed Aes struct → double-free or use-after-free. Additionally, per WOLFKM-ms3.12, the fd_state iv_set flag is not cleared on reset failure, so write() can proceed and call update() → wc_AesCbcEncrypt() on the freed Aes struct. Same structural defect family as WOLFKM-ms3.9/ms3.10/ms3.17.
